title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_un_bien_bel_endroit_pour_mourir_by_rosalie_lowie_n6xvx (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_un_bien_bel_endroit_pour_mourir_by_rosalie_lowie_n6xvx' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a different machine. Removal of the package does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software, as full control may have been granted to an external attacker.
